problem: Production Netlify builds failed before publish because build-localized-routes.mjs made external Anthropic translation success mandatory when STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=1, despite an existing runtime i18n fallback contract.
root_cause: A later fail-closed change reintroduced STATIC_I18N_PRODUCTION_TRANSLATION_FAILED and STATIC_I18N_PRODUCTION_TRANSLATION_REQUIRED, contradicting the earlier production fallback learning and turning an external translation-provider 400 into a full website outage.
prevention: Static English enrichment may use Anthropic during build, but provider failure must not block publication when the canonical runtime translation fallback exists.
Non-transient provider 4xx responses must fail fast; do not spend six retries on a deterministic 400.
Log only a bounded provider error body and status; never log API keys or request credentials.
Always emit /en routes and mark untranslated static output with data-bg-static-translated=false so the runtime layer can translate in place.
LIVE_BEWEZEN still requires production browser proof that the English pricing route visibly renders English; build success alone is insufficient.
